items.description:

Vaga de Arquitetura de Software Backend Developer nível Sênior para atuar em projetos de empresas parceiras da Sylision, na área de Backend.

Faixa salarial: R$ 18.000 a 30.000/mês, conforme experiência.

## Responsabilidades

- Desenvolver e manter serviços de backend
- Modelar dados e integrar sistemas
- Escrever testes e revisar código

100% remoto, para profissionais em Portugal ou no Brasil.

**Obrigatórios:**
- Experiência profissional com Arquitetura de Software (5 anos ou mais)
- Uma linguagem de backend em nível profissional
- APIs REST e SQL
- Git e fluxo de pull request
- Testes automatizados

- Cloud
- Mensageria

items.title: [ $inbox - attractive ] Technical Lead (Payment) [5+ yoe] - Da Nang, HN
items.description:
5+ years of backend engineering experience, with 2+ years in a Tech Lead or equivalent role | AI-first engineering mindset | Ưu tiên kinh nghiệm từ product-based companies | Fluent English (làm việc trực tiếp với team US)

We’re looking for a Tech Lead who can elevate our engineering team from strong to exceptional. You will drive technical excellence, lead the adoption of AI across engineering workflows and products, mentor and grow our developers, and help build a high-performance engineering culture. Working closely with product, design, and leadership teams across Vietnam and the US, you will align technical execution with business goals and ensure the team delivers impactful solutions with speed, quality, and scalability.

WHAT YOU'LL LEAD
You will set technical direction across 2 of our highest-priority initiatives
- Payments: Own the technical direction for billing infrastructure: subscription lifecycle, payment gateways (Stripe and beyond), webhook reliability, and financial reconciliation at scale. Guide the squad through multi-currency, cross-border flows, and marketplace payout systems while maintaining financial data integrity
- Marketplace: Drive backend architecture for discovery, listing management, search/ranking, and transactional flows. Design two-sided systems that scale from thousands to millions of users, covering matching, availability, dynamic pricing, and booking state, with seamless Payments integration.

items.title: [Talent Calling]_Senior Data Engineer_HCMC
items.description:
Our client, a 100% Vietnamese technology company that specializes in turnkey solutions and the formation of highly skilled development teams for businesses of all sizes and industries. 

I. What You’ll Do 
• Enrich a wide range of structured and unstructured data into high-quality datasets for quantitative analysis and financial engineering. 
• Enhance data quality and integrity by developing validation tools and frameworks to measure the effectiveness of data enrichment pipelines. 
• Develop a deep understanding of machine learning, deep learning, and emerging AI/LLM applications, and analyze the underlying dynamics and behaviors within the data. 
• Provide technical support for global researchers, including diagnosing root causes of technical issues, troubleshooting Python and C++ code, and proposing scalable fixes and improvements. 
• Investigate, debug, and resolve issues in C++ applications and data pipelines, with a strong focus on performance, stability, correctness, and maintainability. 
• Explore and apply AI/LLM-based solutions to improve data processing, workflow efficiency, troubleshooting, documentation, and research support processes. 

II. What We’re Looking For 
• Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering, data engineering, machine learning, AI, or related technical domains. 
• Practical experience with, and theoretical understanding of, deep neural networks, machine learning techniques, and modern AI approaches. 
• Demonstrated ability to implement data science pipelines and real-time applications in Python and C++. 
• Strong experience in debugging, troubleshooting, and improving C++ code, including performance analysis, root cause investigation, and code maintainability. 
• Familiarity with AI/LLM tools and applications, including using large language models to support analysis, automation, technical troubleshooting, or workflow optimization. 
• Proficiency with Python-based tools such as Jupyter Notebook and coding standards such as PEP 8. 
• Proficiency with C++ tools and concepts such as STL, object-oriented programming, and debugging best practices. 

Nice to Have 
• Experience as a data scientist or data engineer in finance or investment-related environments. 
• Experience with Linux/Unix shell, Git, and software debugging tools. 
• Experience applying AI/LLM technologies in engineering, analytics, data enrichment, support automation, or developer productivity use cases. 
• Experience optimizing or troubleshooting C++ - based systems in production or research environments. 

Workplace 
• Competitive salary, 13th-month salary, and performance-based bonuses. 
• Comprehensive healthcare package, including statutory and accident insurance. 
• Meal allowance and additional benefits for marriage, newborn, bereavement, and other life events. 
• Modern workplace with a fully stocked pantry and all necessary working equipment provided from day one. 
• Employee support fund for personal loans (e.g., housing, vehicle, education). 
• Clear career development opportunities in a fast-growing technology company.

Contact me for more details (interview process, benefits,...)

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/dungmaingocvn/
